Thanks for looping me in. I reviewed the ask and sketched the minimum redline positions for Legal. High level: we can accept split invoicing, but we need all of the following captured in the Order Form or an annex: 

- Entity mapping table: which legal entity is contract counterparty for the MSA (single counterparty preferred) and which entity receives which invoices.
- Primary payer designation: which entity is responsible for minimum commitment shortfalls / credits. (If StarkWare wants the US entity to hold commercial liability and EMEA to be billed only for local usage, we need that language explicitly.)
- VAT / taxes clause: Redwood will invoice without VAT where StarkWare provides a valid VAT registration/certificate; otherwise taxes will be applied to the invoice in the jurisdiction of service. We need StarkWare to provide VAT certs prior to first invoice for EMEA billing.
- Net terms: if StarkWare requests Net 45/60, Legal asks for Finance to confirm credit exposure and any SLA credit triggers tied to late payments.
- PO and invoice format: Commercial team to confirm PO number format and whether a single PDF invoice can include lines attributed to multiple entities (our AR system can do this, but we need structured PO mapping).

I attached a short redline (.docx) with suggested language. Major open items for our side: confirmation of the commercial counterparty for the MSA; and whether you want Redwood to issue two separate invoices per billing period or a single consolidated invoice with entity line items.

If Marcus can confirm the PO and VAT certs that would speed this. Once we have the PO and certs I’ll send a tracked redline back to you and Ben.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference
